items.name: Solar Panels
items.detail: Panel selection is matched to your roof or ground space, budget and required output as confirmed during design — not a fixed catalogue. Specific brand names appear here only once Sun Power confirms a sourcing relationship.
items.d: Brand-neutral panel selection matched to your site, budget and available space.

items.name: Hybrid Inverters
items.detail: Inverter type and capacity are selected to match your load profile and whether battery backup, grid-tie or hybrid operation is required for your site.
items.d: Residential, commercial and larger-system inverter configurations.

items.name: Batteries / Energy Storage
items.detail: Storage technology and capacity are chosen based on the loads that need to stay powered, your budget and expected battery lifespan for your application.
items.d: Lithium, gel and other appropriate storage technologies.

items.name: Solar Water Pumps
items.detail: Pump type (submersible or surface) is matched to your water source depth, required flow and total dynamic head, confirmed during your site assessment.
items.d: Boreholes, irrigation, livestock and water transfer.

items.name: Solar Water Heaters
items.detail: System type and tank capacity are sized to your daily hot water demand and usage pattern, with integration planned around any existing infrastructure.

items.name: Solar Lighting
items.detail: Fixture type is selected for the application — from self-contained all-in-one units to fixtures wired to a shared battery bank — based on coverage and run-time needs.
items.d: Wall, garden, street, house/security and all-in-one lighting.

items.name: Electrical Protection & Control
items.detail: Protection and control equipment is specified to suit your system design and applicable safety practice. Specific brand names appear only once confirmed by Sun Power.
items.d: Switches, changeover switches, breakers, isolators and protection equipment.

items.name: Mounting & Aluminium Accessories
items.detail: Mounting structure is specified to your roof type, ground conditions or structural requirement, confirmed as part of the site assessment and design.
items.d: Rails, brackets, roof mounting and structural accessories.
